comment: The atv2.wasm this builder version makes: its size and SHA-256 only, never the file. Builds are reproducible (wasi-sdk 34, -ffile-prefix-map for the work folder), so every player's build of the USA retail game is byte-identical to this one. builder.mjs compares its build with it, and the project site's game page accepts exactly this build (the site's tools/sync-play.mjs copies these numbers into play/host/deploy.js). Measured 2026-11-04 from a clean builder 0.4.0 build (work uilderclean4).
